system.description:
The character has strange urges to behave in an alien fashion. They may feel a weird compulsion to burrow, the sensation of urgently needing to lay eggs without any means to fulfill this urge, an instinct to gesture with or clean phantom appendages that don’t map in any way to their anatomy, or a desire to eat substances that would be non-nutritive or even dangerous to terrestrial animal life.

Suggested Game Effects: Under stress, the character exhibits the symptoms of the impulse control disorder (p. 213, EP), but the behavior on which they feel the need to act is something wholly inhuman. Because some of the urges on which they feel impelled to act are anatomically impossible, the character may seek out unusual augmentations or even self-mutilate in the attempt.

Source: Eclipse Phase Transhuman, p. 154.
